title: Velvety Tangy Ukrainian Sirloin Kebabs
description: Tangy and velvety Ukrainian dish featuring sirloin steak, double-fry technique, and ovo-vegetarian friendly ingredients, evoking a sense of nostalgia with its rich flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Pour buttermilk into a separate large bowl.
Dip each sirloin cube into the buttermilk, coating completely, then roll in the flour mixture to coat, placing coated cubes on a plate.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 5-6 coated sirloin cubes to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove fried cubes from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining coated sirloin cubes, adding more oil as needed.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and lemon juice.
Dip each fried sirloin cube into the egg mixture, coating completely, then roll in the flour mixture again to coat.
Heat the remaining 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and fry the double-coated sirloin cubes until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the velvety tangy Ukrainian sirloin kebabs hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
